background: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game asset: original 2D side-scrolling pixel-art basement BACKGROUND, wide landscape 1536x1024. Rich SNES-era pixel art with crisp visible pixel clusters, no smooth painting. Side elevation, orthographic, no perspective floor. A neglected plumbing plant: dark navy and muted teal brick wall, copper pipes, pressure gauges, huge recessed boiler tanks, overhead cable bundles, amber caged lamps, damp stains, tiny green moss. Elegant atmospheric lighting rendered in pixel clusters. Upper ceiling at top, wall fills entire image down to bottom; NO ground plane, NO platforms, NO characters, NO toilets, NO text or signage or UI. It will be drawn behind gameplay with a separate walkable floor at the bottom. Detail subdued, darker lower third so bright player stands out. Original design, not from any existing game. Horizontally repeating composition with dark brick wall along both edges.
sean: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite sheet for an original SNES-style side-scrolling plumbing action game. Exactly 8 evenly spaced cells, 4 columns by 2 rows, square canvas. Each cell contains ONE full body sprite of the SAME stocky middle-aged bald white man with short pointed gray-brown goatee, expressive worried face, orange work shirt, dark teal-blue bib overalls, brown work boots, utility belt, holding a compact brass plumbing launcher with a red plunger muzzle at waist height facing RIGHT. Crisp chunky pixel art, strong dark outlines, limited palette, clean readable silhouette; approximately 40x56 logical pixel character enlarged with nearest-neighbor look. NOT smooth illustration. Same body size, head size, clothing and weapon every frame. Consistent foot baseline in each cell and generous transparent gutters. Row 1: idle ready pose, running right left leg forward, running right passing stride, running right right leg forward. Row 2: running right second passing stride, airborne jump knees bent, firing launcher with arms extended (no projectile or muzzle flash), hurt recoiling with worried expression. Every character faces RIGHT. No shadows below feet, no background, no text, no labels, no grids. Genuine transparent alpha. Original character, not from an existing game.
toilet: Use case: stylized-concept. Production original 2D game pixel-art enemy sprite atlas. Exactly FOUR sprites in a 2x2 equal cell grid on a transparent square canvas, wide clear transparent gutters. Same sentient porcelain toilet monster in all four cells, facing LEFT in three-quarter side view, white porcelain shaded pale teal, chunky navy outline, raised tank at rear right, lid like an angry eyebrow, two glowing coral eyes on bowl, snarling bowl mouth with a few blunt porcelain teeth, squat pipe-like feet. Funny menacing cartoon monster, not horror, no gore. Crisp visible pixel clusters like a detailed SNES-era sprite, limited colors, no smooth painting, no ground shadows. Top left neutral walking left foot forward, top right walking right foot forward, bottom left hop with tucked feet and open mouth, bottom right hit reaction with eyes squeezed shut and small cracks. Consistent size and baseline, fully contained in each cell. Genuine transparent alpha, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no extra props. Original design not from existing games.
